annotation_method: DeepSeek scope descriptions grounded in supplied training-derived genes and existing state labels; no formal GO enrichment or biological review

axes.name: Ribosomal protein gene expression program
axes.summary: Categorical states differ mainly in the signed pattern of ribosomal protein transcripts, with some states also showing mixed proteasome, mitochondrial, S100, or ferritin signals.
axes.uncertainty: A549 pilot features only; states are unordered and may mix functions; no causal or enrichment claims.

axes.name: Chromatin, RNA-processing and cell-cycle associated program
axes.summary: States vary in signed patterns of chromatin, RNA-processing, transport, and cell-cycle-associated transcripts, with several states showing coordinated positive or negative shifts.
axes.uncertainty: A549 pilot features; weak effect sizes in many states; functional interpretation provisional and not causal.

axes.name: Matrix, stress and secretory associated program
axes.summary: States differ in signed patterns of SERPINE1, TGM2, metallothionein, and cytoskeletal/secretory transcripts, with some states showing coordinated stress/matrix-like marker shifts.
axes.uncertainty: A549 pilot features; mixed and modest signals; no causal regulation or formal pathway enrichment implied.

axes.name: Chromatin, transcription and RNA-processing associated program
axes.summary: States vary in signed patterns of chromatin/transcription regulators and RNA-processing genes, with some states showing broad positive or negative shifts in these markers.
axes.uncertainty: A549 pilot features; several states have weak or near-null signals; interpretation provisional and non-causal.

axes.name: Aldehyde/ketoreductase and oxidative-stress marker program
axes.summary: States differ mainly in signed patterns of aldehyde dehydrogenase, ketoreductase, and glutathione peroxidase transcripts, with some mixed keratin or secretory markers.
axes.uncertainty: A549 pilot features; marker-based interpretation only; states are unordered and not causal.

axes.name: PDE4/cAMP and adhesion-associated expression program
axes.summary: States vary in signed patterns of PDE4D, PDE4B, CACNA2D1, MAML3, and adhesion/cytoskeletal transcripts, with generally modest and mixed signals.
axes.uncertainty: A549 pilot features; many states weak or near-null; functional themes uncertain and not causal.

axes.name: Nuclear export, RNA processing and translation-associated program
axes.summary: States differ in signed patterns of nuclear export, RNA-processing, nucleolar, and translation-associated transcripts, with some states showing coordinated up or down shifts.
axes.uncertainty: A549 pilot features; decoder-derived associations; direction is state-specific, not axis-wide, and not causal.

axes.name: Cytoskeletal, transport and trafficking associated program
axes.summary: States vary in signed patterns of ZSWIM6, CCDC88A, WDR70, EXT1, and related trafficking/cytoskeletal transcripts, with several states showing coordinated shifts.
axes.uncertainty: A549 pilot features; effects modest and mixed; interpretation provisional and not causal.

axes.name: Chaperone/proteostasis and replication-marker program
axes.summary: States contrast expression of heat-shock/chaperone genes (HSP90AA1, HSPA1A, STIP1, DNAJA1) with replication markers (PCNA, TK1, CKS2), often in mixed patterns.
axes.uncertainty: A549 pilot axis; states mix chaperone and replication signals and are unordered, so no single direction or causal role is implied.

axes.name: Poorly resolved membrane/ubiquitin-ligase-associated program
axes.summary: States show weak, heterogeneous signed patterns around TMEM131, MDM2, ASCC3 and UBASH3B with no consistent functional theme.
axes.uncertainty: Most state labels are explicitly unclear; evidence supports only that these genes vary, not any pathway.

axes.name: ER/secretory and redox-associated program
axes.summary: States contrast ER/secretory markers (KDELR1, LMAN2, PDIA4/PDIA6, TMED10) and redox/iron genes (NQO1, FTL) with DKK1/ANXA1/SPP1 signals.
axes.uncertainty: A549 pilot axis; ER, redox and secreted-marker patterns co-occur across states and are not shown to be causally linked.

axes.name: Chromatin/transcriptional-regulator-associated program
axes.summary: States vary in expression of chromatin and RNA-processing regulators (NIPBL, ARID4B, GPATCH8, CNOT4) with generally small effect sizes.
axes.uncertainty: Weakest-varying axis; small effects and mixed regulators limit functional interpretation.

axes.name: Nutrient-transport and proliferation/adhesion program
axes.summary: States contrast amino-acid transporter SLC38A1 and RNA-binding LARP1/IGF2BP1 with cell-cycle (CCND1) and adhesion/cytoskeletal (MYOF, DOCK5) markers.
axes.uncertainty: A549 pilot axis; transport, proliferation and adhesion signals appear in separate states and are not demonstrated to be coordinated.

axes.name: Epithelial transport/adhesion-associated program
axes.summary: States show coordinated signed variation in PDE4D, ABCC3, EHBP1 and MTUS1, with several states dominated by joint decreases or increases.
axes.uncertainty: A549 pilot axis; many state labels are marked unclear and the shared regulation of these genes is inferred only from co-variation.

axes.name: Cytoskeletal/adhesion GTPase-regulator program
axes.summary: States contrast expression of cytoskeletal and Rho-GTPase regulators (TRIO, FGD6, PTK2, MBNL1), with several states showing coordinated increases or decreases.
axes.uncertainty: A549 pilot axis; decoder-derived states and mixed splicing/cytoskeletal genes mean no causal signaling role is established.

axes.name: Poorly resolved WWOX/neurodevelopmental-gene program
axes.summary: States vary in WWOX, IMMP2L, BCAS3 and MBD5 expression, often as broad up- or down-shifts without a clear shared function.
axes.uncertainty: State labels repeatedly note unclear biology; evidence supports co-variation only, not a defined pathway.

axes.name: Keratin/adhesion cytoskeletal program
axes.summary: States contrast keratin and catenin/adhesion transcripts (KRT8, KRT18, CTNNA3) with TMSB10 and stress markers, forming several distinct signed patterns rather than one ordered level.
axes.uncertainty: A549 pilot only; states mix keratin-high and keratin-low patterns and some states have unclear function; no causal or enrichment claims.

axes.name: Glycolytic/mitochondrial energy program
axes.summary: States vary between coordinated up- and down-patterns of glycolytic and mitochondrial energy genes (ALDOA, PKM, TPI1, ATP5B/ATP5G3) alongside cytoskeletal CFL1.
axes.uncertainty: A549 pilot; several states are weak or mixed and some combine metabolic with adhesion signals; interpretation is descriptive only.

axes.name: Sterol/lipid and STC1-associated program
axes.summary: States contrast sterol/lipid biosynthesis transcripts (INSIG1, ACSBG1) with STC1, RGL1 and long non-coding RNAs, giving several distinct signed patterns.
axes.uncertainty: A549 pilot; many states are weak or mixed and lncRNA roles are unknown; no causal lipid or signaling claims.

axes.name: p53-marker-associated stress program
axes.summary: States show differing combinations of p53-responsive markers (FDXR, CDKN1A, TP53I3, MDM2, RPS27L), often with internally inconsistent directions across markers.
axes.uncertainty: A549 pilot; marker directions are frequently discordant across states, so a single p53 pathway interpretation is not supported.

axes.name: Lysosomal/secretory program
axes.summary: States vary in lysosomal and secretory transcripts (PSAP, CTSB, GRN, NUCB1, LGALS3BP) with some keratin (KRT19) and clusterin co-expression.
axes.uncertainty: A549 pilot; several states are weak or unclear and lysosomal/secretory labels are provisional, not measured activity.

axes.name: Adhesion/junction-associated program
axes.summary: States contrast adhesion and junction transcripts (FKBP5, PCDH9, SDK2, EPB41L4A) with cytoskeletal genes, spanning coordinated high and low patterns.
axes.uncertainty: A549 pilot; FKBP5 has stress-related roles and several states are weak or broadly down, limiting specificity.

axes.name: Mitochondrial-encoded OXPHOS program
axes.summary: States largely separate high versus low patterns of mitochondrial-encoded respiratory transcripts (MT-CO2, MT-ATP6, MT-CYB, MT-ND2) with few other markers.
axes.uncertainty: A549 pilot; positive markers are almost entirely mitochondrial-encoded genes and negative markers are weak, so function beyond this transcript set is unresolved.

axes.name: SERTAD2/RYBP/USP15 regulatory program
axes.summary: States show varying combinations of SERTAD2, RYBP, USP15, TAF3 and HIF1A-AS2, with several weak or mixed patterns and no single dominant direction.
axes.uncertainty: A549 pilot; effects are modest and states are heterogeneous, so functional interpretation is tentative and non-causal.

axes.name: Cell-cycle/proliferation-associated program
axes.summary: States contrast coordinated expression of proliferation and mitotic genes (MKI67, TOP2A, CENPF, ASPM) against replication/repair-leaning patterns, with several low-proliferation states.
axes.uncertainty: A549 pilot only; states mix proliferation and repair signals and are not ordered activity levels; no causal claim.

axes.name: Redox/ubiquitin-chromatin regulatory program
axes.summary: States vary in expression of TXNRD1, KMT2A, PPP6R3, RERE and ITCH, suggesting a mixed redox, chromatin and ubiquitin-ligase-associated program.
axes.uncertainty: A549 pilot; many states have weak or near-zero opposing effects and the theme is heterogeneous; no causal or pathway claim.

axes.name: Long noncoding RNA / neuronal-like program
axes.summary: States center on MALAT1 and NEAT1 along with neuronal-associated genes such as SYT1, MAP2 and RORA, with several low-lncRNA states.
axes.uncertainty: A549 pilot; neuronal interpretation is tentative and many states show weak or mixed effects; not a universal axis.

axes.name: EGFR/TGFBI/ECM signaling-associated program
axes.summary: States contrast coordinated high expression of EGFR, TGFBI, BICC1, NTRK3 and DCBLD2 against low-signal states, with some HIF1A-linked patterns.
axes.uncertainty: A549 pilot; states mix signaling, matrix and hypoxia signals; no causal regulation or formal enrichment implied.

axes.name: Stress/secretory and cytoskeletal program
axes.summary: States vary in TFPI2, ARL6IP1, H1FX, SLC9A3R1 and SQSTM1, suggesting a mixed stress, secretory and chromatin/cytoskeletal program.
axes.uncertainty: A549 pilot; many states are weak or nonspecific and functions are heterogeneous; interpretation is provisional.

axes.name: Cytoskeletal/chaperone expression program
axes.summary: States contrast high expression of tubulins, VIM, CCT5 and NPM1 against tubulin-low states, consistent with a cytoskeletal and chaperone-associated program.
axes.uncertainty: A549 pilot; several states are low-signal or mixed with metabolic/translational hints; no causal claim.

axes.name: PRKCA/EPS8 signaling-associated program
axes.summary: States vary in PRKCA, EPS8, FAM214A, STK3 and related genes, with some states showing coordinated high and others coordinated low expression.
axes.uncertainty: A549 pilot; effect sizes are modest and several states are mixed or unclear; no causal regulation implied.

axes.name: SLC12A2/CYP24A1 transport-metabolic program
axes.summary: States center on SLC12A2, CYP24A1, BASP1 and PDE10A, with coordinated high or low patterns and some SLC7A11/MAP7 co-variation.
axes.uncertainty: A549 pilot; most states are described as functionally unclear and effects are mixed; interpretation is provisional.
